parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of a bucket, typically made of steel wire for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows the user to lift and carry the bucket easily, distributing the weight evenly.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can pivot or rotate around its attachment points on the bucket body to facilitate carrying and pouring.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the bucket, typically made of plastic to hold liquids or solids.
parts.Functional_description: The base body serves as the container portion of the bucket, holding the contents securely.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is a rigid, non-moving part that provides structural support and containment for the bucket.
